materialized_controls.head: fff93e35c77e396a44499837e8f5fca681ef39fa
materialized_controls.role: exact machine-readable casewise N_lo/N_hi timing controls

purpose: Measure steady-state computational cost only after realized-error comparators have been frozen independently of timing. For 34 bracketed cases, time RossFast N1 and both Reference bracket endpoints N_lo/N_hi. For two left-censored B12 cases, time RossFast N1 and Reference N1 and report them separately.

rossfast.initialization: Material tables and solver binding are initialized once per case before warmup and excluded from primary timed regions.

reference.note: This is a research Richards comparator, not the current production Reference tolerance policy.
reference.bracketed: Time casewise frozen N_lo and N_hi from P2E23.
reference.left_censored: Time Reference N1 only; it is already more accurate than RossFast N1.

comparator_semantics.ref_high: P2E21 REF-HIGH is used only for untimed preflight verification and never inside a timed region.

execution_environment.compiler: gfortran -O2 for the frozen benchmark executable
execution_environment.affinity: must be pinned to the host-admitted CPU set
execution_environment.smt: all siblings of the measured CPU must be reserved as required by MP-8
execution_environment.frequency_policy: must match the admitted runner attestation
execution_environment.host_identity: must match the MP-8 readiness and MP-7 admission evidence used by the timing run
execution_environment.prohibition: ubuntu-latest, ordinary shared runners and unadmitted hosts are not publication timing environments

warmup_and_batches.benchmark_unit: one frozen case and its preregistered configuration; each measured process batch repeats the same 0.0016-day horizon a common number of times for all configurations of that case

repetition_calibration.rule: Double a common per-case repetition count until the minimum child_cpu_seconds among that case's frozen timed configurations is at least 0.25 s.
repetition_calibration.if_maximum_reached_before_target: BLOCK_CASE_TIMING_RESOLUTION; do not choose solver-specific repetition counts

warmup_and_batches.bracketed_order_schedule: The six orders repeat exactly four times, yielding 24 measured cycles.
warmup_and_batches.left_censored_order_schedule: Alternate the two orders for 24 measured cycles.
warmup_and_batches.first_timing_exposure_rule: The first admitted-host execution that reaches measured timing is the primary timing exposure. A later rerun is reproducibility/infrastructure evidence and cannot silently replace it.

clocks.primary: operating-system child CPU seconds measured externally around the benchmark process, consistent with MP-6/MP-7 semantics
clocks.secondary: monotonic wall_elapsed_seconds measured externally with perf_counter_ns around the same process
clocks.timing_scope: Includes repeated complete configured-solver horizon execution and route/mass/transfer validation. Excludes case construction, REF-HIGH reconstruction, table/model initialization, repetition calibration, warmup and output formatting.

host_gate: MP-8 runner_contract_ready=true on the executing runner
full MP-7 host admission passed on the same runner configuration
host-admission child-CPU minimum detectable relative effect <= 0.01
zero cgroup throttling over the host-admission qualification window
before_any_measured_batch: reproduce RossFast N1 endpoint and P2E23 realized error/storage gate untimed
reproduce frozen Reference N_lo/N_hi or N1 endpoint(s) untimed
verify route, integrated mass, prescribed transfer identity and P2E23 classification
verify benchmark executable produces the frozen variant-specific scientific fingerprint
preflight.failure_policy: Any failed host or scientific preflight stops before measured timing. Do not change N_lo/N_hi, tolerance policy, case population or host-resolution target.

per_configuration_statistics.batch_records: Emit child CPU and wall seconds per horizon for every measured cycle and configuration.
per_configuration_statistics.paired_primary_quantity: For each cycle, d_hi = cpu_REF_HI/cpu_ROSS - 1. For bracket sensitivity, d_lo = cpu_REF_LO/cpu_ROSS - 1.
central_estimates: median absolute deviation of per-horizon CPU time
per_configuration_statistics.resolution_rule: MDE = 2 * stdev(d) / sqrt(24) separately for d_hi and d_lo, following the repository performance-resolution convention.

bracketed.primary: Reference N_hi versus RossFast N1 because N_hi is the least-refined tested Richards configuration with equal-or-better realized scientific error.
bracketed.sensitivity: Reference N_lo versus RossFast N1 brackets the lower-cost side while carrying just-worse scientific error.

left_censored.interpretation: Conservative descriptive comparison because Reference N1 is already more accurate; never label strict equal-error.

primary_summaries: median and geometric mean of cpu_REF_HI/cpu_ROSS across 34 bracketed cases
interquartile range and min/max of cpu_REF_HI/cpu_ROSS
same descriptive summaries for the N_lo sensitivity bracket
population_analysis.censored_population: Report cases 7 and 8 separately and do not mix them into strict matched-error population summaries.

setup_cost.reason: The publication question is steady-state production solve cost over repeated model time windows; RossFast table/model initialization is a startup cost amortized across a simulation.
setup_cost.optional_secondary: A later separately labeled setup-cost measurement may be reported, but cannot alter the primary timing result.

outcome_policy.timing_noise: Retain noisy cases with flags; do not rerun selectively.
outcome_policy.partial_failure: If a scientific preflight fails, stop before measured timing in the primary run. If infrastructure fails after timing has begun, persist/identify the exposure and do not relabel a rerun as first exposure.
outcome_policy.interpretation: A timing result may support, refute, or leave unresolved a computational advantage. Scientific admission results remain valid regardless.

performance_governance.rule: P2E24 may not reach measured timing until the same runner satisfies the MP-8 isolated-runner contract and the full MP-7 host-admission protocol, including the 1% child-CPU resolution gate and zero full-window throttling.

infrastructure_status.consequence: P2E24 protocol may be implemented and benchmark fingerprints may be qualified untimed, but measured timing must not be launched.

next_permitted_action: Materialize and qualify the P2E24 benchmark executable and variant-specific scientific fingerprints without timing. In parallel, provision/identify an isolated swap5-performance runner, pass MP-8 readiness, then repeat the full MP-7 host-admission protocol. Only then execute P2E24 measured timing unchanged.
